scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install express cors dotenv prisma @prisma/client && npx prisma generate && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.nuke: npm run clean:ports && rm -rf frontend/dist server/dist
scripts.audit:all: npm audit && cd server && npm audit && cd ../frontend && npm audit
scripts.audit:ci: npm audit --audit-level=high && cd server && npm audit --audit-level=high && cd ../frontend && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.audit:fix:all: npm audit fix && cd server && npm audit fix && cd ../frontend && npm audit fix
scripts.validate: npm run setup && npm run build:client
scripts.upgrade:all: npx npm-check-updates -u && cd server && npx npm-check-updates -u && cd ../frontend && npx npm-check-updates -u && cd .. && npm run refresh
scripts.refresh: npm run clean && rm -f package-lock.json server/package-lock.json frontend/package-lock.json && npm run setup
